answer.reason: The Philistine camp at Michmash and the rout of the Philistines from Michmash to Aijalon are events of the place, beyond the list entries.

clauses.english: was where the Philistines pitched their camp against Israel
clauses.quote: and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Bethaven

clauses.english: was the starting point of Israel's slaughter of the Philistines as far as Aijalon
clauses.quote: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon

doubts: The Ezra, Nehemiah and Isaiah verses only list the men of Michmas, record where Benjamites dwelt, or describe an advance in prophecy, so they were not used.
